title: Goal Mode compile acceptance
canonical_summary: Compiling this ledger should produce a canonical Goal Runtime/System plan document and consumer PlanUnits that preserve every ready atom, carry gui_related classification, separate visible vs invisible behavior, include backend/runtime contracts, and explicitly defer Chain Wizard/node graph details that depend on later design.
gui_classification_reason: Backend/orchestration or product architecture; not GUI/UI or visual implementation work.

title: Main product risk: false completion by weak agents
canonical_summary: The highest-risk failure mode is a weak model reading massive sharded inputs, missing material content or hallucinating issues/non-issues, then falsely judging the goal complete. The design must make false completion structurally difficult.
negative_constraints: Do not let confidence replace coverage/evidence.
gui_classification_reason: Backend/orchestration or product architecture; not GUI/UI or visual implementation work.

title: Main UX risk: hidden work without control
canonical_summary: For visible assistant-chat goals, the UX risk is that a long-running goal feels hidden or uncontrollable. The UI must show active status, current tasks, progress, subagents, pause/resume/stop/update controls, and inspectable evidence.
gui_classification_reason: Assistant-chat or user-visible GUI/visual behavior.

title: Main internal-flow risk: user interruption for ordinary blockers
canonical_summary: For invisible Chain Wizard goals, the UX/product risk is interrupting the user for ordinary ambiguity. The runtime should autonomously resolve/disposition ordinary ambiguity and only stop for true hard blockers.
negative_constraints: Do not involve the user in internal ledger-to-plan transfer unless a true hard stop exists.
gui_classification_reason: Backend/orchestration or product architecture; not GUI/UI or visual implementation work.

title: Goal completion reports
canonical_summary: Each goal should produce or expose a final completion report appropriate to its visibility level: concise user-facing summary for assistant chat, machine-readable evidence/certification artifacts for internal goals, and changed files/tests/validators/blockers in inspectable logs.
gui_classification_reason: Assistant-chat or user-visible GUI/visual behavior.
